segments.name: Falcon's Creative Group
segments.description: Provides creative and advisory services, including destination strategy, master planning and attraction design, to entertainment and hospitality destination clients.
segments.evidence: FCG generates revenues from master planning, attraction design, experiential entertainment, content production, interactives, and software.

segments.name: Destinations Operations
segments.description: Provides development and management services for themed entertainment to PDP and operates entertainment venues and branded destination concepts.
segments.evidence: Destinations Operations recognizes management and incentive fees from the Company's equity method investments.

segments.name: PDP
segments.description: Develops, owns and operates hotels, theme parks and retail, dining and entertainment venues in Spain.
segments.evidence: PDP develops, owns and operates hotels, theme parks and retail, dining and entertainment venues.

segments.name: Falcon's Attractions
segments.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures and sells ride systems and attraction hardware to theme parks, location-based venues and destination developers.
segments.evidence: The integration of OES into Falcon's Attractions provides the Company with expanded capabilities in the design and manufacture of advanced attraction and show systems.

segments.name: Falcon's Beyond Brands-Other
segments.description: Develops and commercializes Company owned and third-party intellectual property through consumer products and media.
segments.evidence: Falcon's Beyond Brands-Other is utilized for the development and commercialization of Company owned and third-party intellectual property through consumer products and media.

revenueModel.text: Third-party customers and affiliated entities, including equity method investees, pay fees for design, creative, attraction and destination services.
revenueModel.evidence: FCG generates revenue primarily through the provision of design, consulting, creative, and related professional services to third-party customers and affiliated entities.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company acquired OES and integrated it into the new Falcon's Attractions segment.
changes.evidence: During May 2025, the Company acquired OES and integrated it into the new Falcon's Attractions segment.

changes.text: The Company had four operating segments in 2024 and five reportable operating segments in 2025.
changes.evidence: Therefore, as of December 31, 2025 the Company has five reportable operating segments.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company's joint venture PDP sold the Sol Tenerife Hotel.
changes.evidence: In May 2025, the Company, through its joint venture PDP, completed the disposition of the Sol Tenerife Hotel by selling 100% of its equity interests in Tertian XXI, S.L., the entity owning the real-estate assets.
